These normalized measures exclude construction-related items; do not call them audited statutory TTM earnings. Net debt was EGP 5.53bn, and K-12 normalized EBITDA weakened despite group growth [results]. Admissions and future annual results can test growth durability; planned projects are not assured revenue. The July release discusses longer-dated launches, so these are medium-term execution hypotheses rather than near-term guarantees [results].

The issuer dividend table ends in 2024 and has ambiguous PT units [dividends]; do not infer no later dividend or use it to adjust returns.
